description: Electricity Network - View Service (INSPIRE) is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo-inspire.trafikverket.se. Geodata service/display service (wms) for non-linear power lines according to INSPIRE Directive. For use in applications. Open the service by pasting the access address link into the appropriate software. Coverage: SE. Its keywords include view service, visningstjänst, INSPIRE. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-03-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
